# Drivable

> Drivable helps new drivers pass the DMV written permit test, with an AI coach, a full-length mock permit exam, and state-specific road signs and traffic law quizzes.

Drivable adapts prep to the learner's state and target test date, tracks readiness, and coaches on rules of the road, signs, and safe driving habits.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What Drivable does, features, and pricing for the Free Pass and Pro Pass.

- [DMV Road Test Checklist](/guides/road-test-checklist): Documents to bring, vehicle requirements, pre drive safety check, scored maneuvers, and the automatic fail list.
